The '''Kwapi system''' was a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Kwapi pirates]].<ref name="GaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kwapi [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-3.<ref name="EAOC" />
